name: Hôtel Récamier
features: Central location; accessible by metro (lines 4 and 12); no on-site car park encourages public transport use. Environmental features reported by source: energy-efficient lighting, linen reuse programme.

name: Generator Paris
features: Budget eco-friendly hostel. Located near Gare du Nord with excellent public transport links. Environmental features reported by source: recycling programme, LED lighting.

name: Pullman Paris Tour Eiffel
features: Near Trocadéro metro. Environmental features reported by source: ISO 14001 certified, water-saving fixtures, locally sourced restaurant options.

name: The Curtain Hotel
features: Shoreditch location; excellent public transport (Old Street/Liverpool Street). Environmental features reported by source: rooftop garden, responsibly sourced food, sustainability programme.

name: citizenM London Bankside
features: Walking distance from Borough Market and Tate Modern. Environmental features reported by source: carbon neutral since 2020 (self-reported), renewable energy, water recycling.

name: Hotel Indigo London Paddington
features: Direct rail links from Paddington. Environmental features reported by source: IHG Green Engage programme, energy monitoring.

name: Hotel Ottilia
features: Located in a converted brewery. Excellent public transport connections. Environmental features reported by source: renewable energy, bike hire on-site, organic breakfast.

name: 25hours Hotel Bikini Berlin
features: Zoo/Tiergarten area with excellent U-Bahn access. Environmental features reported by source: recycled furnishings, social responsibility programme.

name: Hotel Arts Barcelona
features: Beachfront location near Barceloneta metro. Environmental features reported by source: ISO 14001 certified, energy management system.

name: Praktik Rambla
features: Heart of Las Ramblas; walkable to major attractions. Environmental features reported by source: energy efficient design, locally sourced breakfast.

name: NH Collection Amsterdam
features: Near Centraal Station; bike hire available. Environmental features reported by source: EU Ecolabel certified (self-reported), energy and water saving measures.
